name: Minecraft / MineRL / MineDojo
description: Minecraft is a 3D open-world sandbox with infinite procedurally generated worlds supporting survival, crafting, building, resource management, combat, and emergent multi-agent interactions. World state persists and evolves based on player actions. MineRL provides a dataset of 60M+ human demonstrations and RL environments; MineDojo offers a unified framework with thousands of diverse open-ended tasks specified via language and video. The BASALT competition extends this for evaluating human-like behavior without dense rewards.
typical_sota_score: ObtainDiamond: <5% for most RL agents; LLM agents (Voyager) unlock significantly more skills
reputation: The premier open-world benchmark; 60M+ human demos in MineRL; Voyager/DEPS demonstrate LLM agent pipelines; BASALT competition for human-judgment evaluation; widely regarded as the ultimate open-ended agent testbed.
notes: World state changes persist across sessions — structures remain, resources deplete. MineRL dataset enables imitation and RLHF-style training. MineDojo has 1000s of language-specified tasks. Natively playable by humans; extensive LLM pipelines via vision/language interfaces. Hierarchical long-horizon planning required.
